stations.title: Tick button
stations.text: Marit put one on every route.

captions: The board comes from data now. Members want to tick the routes they climbed.
A member taps Tick on Slab Happy, and nothing on the board changes.
You make the board show ticks and hear every tap, in three tasks.
Now the tap reaches the board, and Slab Happy shows as ticked.
Tick, untick, tick again. The buttons and the count always agree.
